base_rule: Original vision_adaptive H5 threshold and radius are the shared baseline. Two online response gains and same common polynomial candidate bank in every arm. Only reference use and allowance change. Tier-specific calibration of multiplier from nominal calibration families only.
reference_access: A pre-recorded unmodified expert reference at each block root is supplied to all arms. Vision tier receives its rendered history/proprioception and uses the same known-shape/color estimator as current execution. State tier receives true current/reference states as a privileged diagnostic. Neither tier receives future counterfactual outcomes for selection. True future reference trajectory is evaluation-only.
remaining_margin: Compute max(current-reference normalized position/rotation error), remaining=max(0,1-error), multiply base radius/tau by calibration multiplier and remaining. This is a proxy, not a safety guarantee.
reference_forecast: Roll current candidate from current observed root and nominal expert actions from supplied reference root using the same current-past fitted contact-response gains. Limit maximum difference between these predicted object trajectories over5actions+3suffix. This predicts accumulated deviation rather than only the candidate-minus-nominal local effect. No future true object states used.
calibration: For constant_shrink,remaining_margin,reference_forecast choose one multiplier per tier by maximizing global joint preservation+jerk success subject to overall/contact applied risk<=0.1 and active>=0.25. If infeasible choose minimum-risk diagnostic setting and explicitly flag no feasible deployment rule. Local arm keeps original rule. No development/test tuning.
evaluation: Same20actions+3core suffix and up10long suffix as prior repeated experiment. E_long=max(E_core,raw_long_E) retains coverage checks. Record terminal velocity at20 and23actions, drift, first violation, correction stop and persistent violation. Fallback does not reset accumulated deviation.
scope: Reference-available expert replay, not deployable counterfactual reference for a closed-loop policy. Vision and privileged-state tiers separate. No claim that current margin alone bounds future error. Same model predicts both roots; approximation and stale dynamics may still fail. Finaltest locked.
